messages:
jess_support: FYI customer Acme Logistics raised a decline on invoice INV-3432 when paying with their corporate Visa. They reported 'card declined' on checkout. Stripe webhook shows decline_code: merchant_category_blocked. Need help — does Redwood block MCCs or is this issuer? :thinking:

stripe-bot: Stripe event charge.failed
```
id: ch_1Lx...xyz
amount: 1245000
currency: usd
status: failed
failure_message: "Card was declined"
decline_code: "merchant_category_blocked"
outcome: {network_status: "declined_by_issuer", reason: "merchant_category_restricted"}
```

alex_billing: We don't block MCCs on our side. This looks like the issuer/card admin blocking purchases for that merchant category. Do we have customer's last4 and BIN? Also was there 3DS? :mag:

jess_support: Last4 4242, BIN 424242. They said it's a corporate procurement card with strict MCC and single-transaction limit of $10,000. Invoice is $12,450. Attached their screenshot.

tony_finance: If the card has a per-transaction cap, that'll cause decline. Merchant category restrictions are also set by issuer—can't override. Recommend offering PO + wire/ACH for Net30 or ask them to use a different card. We can also create a manual invoice and mark pending until payment confirmed. :thumbsup:

jess_support: Customer says they require vendor to accept PO before payment can be made. Can we generate a PO-compatible invoice and email them wiring instructions? 

alex_billing: Yes — we can issue a manual invoice with PO field filled. I'll generate INV-3432-manual and include wire details. For Stripe, nothing to change. Ticketing note added.

jess_support: Suggested message to customer:
```
Hi Sara,

Thanks — we can accept a PO and process payment via wire/ACH. We'll issue an updated invoice with PO reference INV-3432-PO. Please confirm when you initiate the transfer and send remittance.

If you'd prefer to retry card payment, please contact your card administrator to whitelist 'Software and Cloud Services' MCC or lift the single-transaction cap for the payment.

Best,
Jess (Redwood Support)
```

tony_finance: I'll approve the manual invoice and monitor for wire. Alex — please set terms Net30 and tag finance:po-required. 

alex_billing: On it. I'll also add a note to block auto-retries for this charge to avoid repeated declines. 

jess_support: Customer replied: they'll open a ticket with their card admin but need the PO invoice now. Sending manual invoice and wire details, looping @tony_finance. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: reminder: log payment events to billing.audit for compliance

jess_support: Closing for now — action items: alex to create manual PO invoice, tony to watch for wire, customer to try admin unblock if they want to retry card. Reopen if any issues.
